blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP ⟨1⟩ 的法律地位：章節編號低於 1000 = 強制性（Mandatory），適用於所有非經口給藥的無菌製劑
blocks.en: Understand the legal status of USP ⟨1⟩: chapter numbers below 1000 are mandatory and apply to all sterile preparations not administered orally

blocks.zh: 掌握注射劑（Injections）與植入劑（Implants）的完整分類：溶液、懸浮液、乳劑、凍乾粉末、微粒、藥物洗脫支架
blocks.en: Master the full classification of injections and implants: solutions, suspensions, emulsions, lyophilized powders, microparticles and drug-eluting stents

blocks.zh: 區分 Universal Tests（全品項通用測試）與 Specific Tests（劑型特定測試）的架構
blocks.en: Distinguish the structure of Universal Tests (applicable to all products) and Specific Tests (dosage form-specific)

blocks.zh: 理解本章如何觸發其他 USP 章節：⟨71⟩ 無菌試驗、⟨85⟩ 細菌內毒素、⟨788⟩/⟨790⟩ 微粒物質等
blocks.en: Understand how this chapter triggers other USP chapters: ⟨71⟩ Sterility Tests, ⟨85⟩ Bacterial Endotoxins, ⟨788⟩/⟨790⟩ Particulate Matter, and others

blocks.zh: 掌握容器密封系統（Container-Closure Integrity）、標籤（Labeling）、包裝系統的基本要求
blocks.en: Master the basic requirements for container-closure integrity, labeling and packaging systems

blocks.zh: 認識 CDMO 場景下 ⟨1⟩ 的核心角色：定義 QC 放行檢驗的「必做清單」
blocks.en: Recognize the core role of ⟨1⟩ in a CDMO setting: it defines the "must-do list" for QC release testing

blocks.zh: Introduction — 緒論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析
blocks.en: Core Concept Analysis

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1⟩ 的「觸發器」角色：這是整個 USP 無菌製劑品質測試體系的「總目錄」。當個別藥品的 USP 專論（Monograph）引用 ⟨1⟩ 時，就等於啟動了一整串的品質測試要求。
blocks.en: The "trigger" role of USP ⟨1⟩: This chapter is the "master index" of the USP quality testing system for sterile products. When an individual USP monograph references ⟨1⟩, it activates a whole series of quality testing requirements.

blocks.zh: 章節 <1000 = 強制性（Mandatory）— 必須遵守
blocks.en: Chapters <1000 = Mandatory: must be complied with

blocks.zh: 章節 ≥1000 = 資訊性（Informational）— 除非專論明確引用，否則僅供參考
blocks.en: Chapters ≥1000 = Informational: for reference only unless explicitly cited by a monograph

blocks.zh: 三層架構：
blocks.en: Three-tier structure:

blocks.zh: Universal Tests — 所有注射劑都必須做的基本測試
blocks.en: Universal Tests: basic tests that all injections must undergo

blocks.zh: Specific Tests — 根據劑型需額外考慮的測試
blocks.en: Specific Tests: additional tests to be considered depending on the dosage form

blocks.zh: Dosage Form-Specific Tests — 各劑型的完整測試清單（Universal + Specific 的組合）
blocks.en: Dosage Form-Specific Tests: the complete test list for each dosage form (a combination of Universal and Specific tests)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 駕照考試的分級制度：
blocks.en: The tiered system of a driving test:

blocks.zh: 把 USP ⟨1⟩ 想像成交通部的「駕照考試總則」。不管你考的是汽車、機車還是大客車，都有一些「通用科目」（筆試、路考基本項目）— 這就是 Universal Tests。但如果你考大客車，還需要額外的特殊科目（倒車入庫、S 彎）— 這就是 Specific Tests。而每種車型的「完整考試清單」— 就是 Dosage Form-Specific Tests。
blocks.en: Think of USP ⟨1⟩ as the general rules of a driving test set by the transport authority. Whether you are testing for a car, a motorcycle or a bus license, there are "common subjects" (the written exam and the basic road-test items); these are the Universal Tests. But if you are testing for a bus license, there are additional special subjects (reversing into a bay, S-curves); these are the Specific Tests. And the complete exam list for each vehicle type is the Dosage Form-Specific Tests.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CDMO 實務
blocks.en: Key Point: CDMO Practice

blocks.zh: 強制 vs 資訊的實務影響：在 CDMO 場景下，這個區分至關重要。當客戶說「我的產品需要符合 USP ⟨1⟩」，你的 QC 團隊必須執行所有 Universal Tests，並根據劑型決定 Specific Tests。這不是建議，是法規要求。
blocks.en: Practical impact of mandatory vs. informational: In a CDMO setting, this distinction is critical. When a client says "my product needs to comply with USP ⟨1⟩", your QC team must perform all Universal Tests and decide on the Specific Tests according to the dosage form. This is not a recommendation; it is a regulatory requirement.

blocks.zh: 生物製劑的特殊性：原文特別提到生物製劑可能不完全適用 ⟨1⟩ 的定義，但如果專論標題包含「Injection」，仍然必須遵守。CDMO 承接生物製劑客戶時，需要仔細確認專論的具體引用範圍。
blocks.en: The special nature of biologics: The original text notes that biologics may not fully fit the definitions in ⟨1⟩, but if the monograph title includes "Injection", compliance is still required. When a CDMO takes on a biologics client, it needs to confirm carefully the specific scope of the monograph's references.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Exercises for Reflection

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠目前生產哪些注射劑型？請對照 ⟨1⟩ 的分類，確認你的產品屬於哪個類別（Solution / Lyophilized / Suspension 等）。
blocks.en: Which injectable dosage forms does your CDMO site currently manufacture? Compare them with the classification in ⟨1⟩ and confirm which category each product falls into (solution, lyophilized, suspension, etc.).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 把章節分為 <1000（強制）和 ≥1000（資訊）？這種設計對 CDMO 的品質系統建構有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does USP divide chapters into <1000 (mandatory) and ≥1000 (informational)? What does this design mean for how a CDMO builds its quality system?

blocks.zh: 如果一個新客戶帶來一個「注射用凍乾微粒」產品，它同時涉及 ⟨1⟩ 中的哪幾個劑型分類？
blocks.en: If a new client brings a "lyophilized microparticle for injection" product, which dosage form categories in ⟨1⟩ does it involve at the same time?

blocks.zh: Universal Tests — 全品項通用測試
blocks.en: Universal Tests: Tests Applicable to All Products

blocks.zh: 出國前的安全檢查清單：
blocks.en: The pre-flight safety checklist:

blocks.zh: Universal Tests 就像飛機起飛前的「標準檢查清單」。不管是波音 737 還是空中巴士 A380，都必須完成的基本項目：引擎正常（Assay）、機身辨識正確（Identification）、燃油沒有雜質（Impurities）、座艙密封（CCI）、乘客安全（Sterility）。少做任何一項，飛機就不能起飛 — 同理，少做任何一項 Universal Test，批次就不能放行。
blocks.en: Universal Tests are like the "standard checklist" before an aircraft takes off. Whether it is a Boeing 737 or an Airbus A380, certain basic items must be completed: the engines work (Assay), the airframe is correctly identified (Identification), there are no contaminants in the fuel (Impurities), the cabin is sealed (CCI), and the passengers are safe (Sterility). Skip any one item and the plane cannot take off; likewise, skip any one Universal Test and the batch cannot be released.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 微粒物質的四層防線
blocks.en: Key Point: The Four Lines of Defense Against Particulate Matter

blocks.zh: ⟨1⟩ 對微粒物質的要求特別嚴格，建立了四層檢測體系：
blocks.en: ⟨1⟩ is particularly strict about particulate matter and establishes a four-layer testing system:

blocks.zh: ⟨787⟩ — 蛋白質注射劑的不可見微粒（Therapeutic Proteins 專用）
blocks.en: ⟨787⟩: subvisible particulate matter in protein injections (specific to therapeutic proteins)

blocks.zh: ⟨788⟩ — 一般注射劑的不可見微粒（Light Obscuration / Microscopy）
blocks.en: ⟨788⟩: subvisible particulate matter in injections in general (light obscuration / microscopy)

blocks.zh: ⟨789⟩ — 眼內溶液的不可見微粒
blocks.en: ⟨789⟩: subvisible particulate matter in ophthalmic solutions

blocks.zh: ⟨790⟩ — 可見微粒的目視檢查標準
blocks.en: ⟨790⟩: visual inspection standard for visible particulates

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：你的 100% 目視檢查（Visual Inspection）流程必須經過確效（Qualification），而且「任何含可見微粒的容器必須被剔除」— 這是零容忍標準。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: Your 100% visual inspection process must be qualified, and "any container with visible particulates must be rejected". This is a zero-tolerance standard.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 容器密封完整性（CCI）
blocks.en: Key Point: Container-Closure Integrity (CCI)

blocks.zh: ⟨1207⟩ 系列的重要性：CCI 是近年法規關注的焦點。原文要求驗證必須證明「無微生物穿透」且「無化學或物理參數的增減」。
blocks.en: The importance of the ⟨1207⟩ series: CCI has been a focus of regulators in recent years. The original text requires that validation demonstrate "no microbial ingress" and "no increase or decrease in chemical or physical parameters".

blocks.zh: 這意味著你不能只做微生物挑戰測試 — 還需要證明容器不會有氣體洩漏（影響凍乾產品的真空度）或水分侵入（影響凍乾餅的穩定性）。
blocks.en: This means you cannot rely on microbial challenge testing alone. You also need to show that the container does not allow gas leakage (which affects the vacuum in lyophilized products) or moisture ingress (which affects the stability of the lyophilized cake).

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 場景中，Universal Tests 的 9 大項目中，哪些是在充填線上「即時」執行的，哪些是送 QC 實驗室「離線」測試的？
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, of the 9 categories of Universal Tests, which are performed "in-process" on the filling line, and which are tested "off-line" in the QC laboratory?

blocks.zh: 原文要求 Assay 必須使用「specific and stability-indicating」方法。為什麼穩定性指示（Stability-indicating）這個要求如此重要？
blocks.en: The original text requires the Assay to use a "specific and stability-indicating" method. Why is the stability-indicating requirement so important?

blocks.zh: ⟨85⟩ 和 ⟨151⟩ 都能用於內毒素/熱原檢測，但實務上 CDMO 幾乎只用 ⟨85⟩。為什麼？
blocks.en: Both ⟨85⟩ and ⟨151⟩ can be used for endotoxin/pyrogen testing, but in practice CDMOs use almost only ⟨85⟩. Why?

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Universal Tests 的全貌
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Full Picture of Universal Tests

blocks.zh: Universal Tests 就是你的 QC 實驗室對每一批注射劑產品都必須執行的「基本檢驗清單」。共有 9 大類：
blocks.en: Universal Tests are the "basic test list" that your QC laboratory must perform on every batch of injectable product. There are 9 categories in total:

blocks.zh: Specific Tests — 劑型特定測試
blocks.en: Specific Tests: Dosage Form-Specific Tests

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Specific Tests 的「按需觸發」邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The "On-Demand Trigger" Logic of Specific Tests

blocks.zh: Specific Tests 不像 Universal Tests 那樣「一律適用」。它們是根據產品特性「按需啟動」的附加測試。關鍵觸發條件：
blocks.en: Specific Tests are not "always applicable" the way Universal Tests are. They are additional tests that are "activated on demand" according to product characteristics. The key triggers are:

blocks.zh: 單劑量容器 → 需要做 Uniformity of Dosage Units ⟨905⟩
blocks.en: Single-dose container → Uniformity of Dosage Units ⟨905⟩ is required

blocks.zh: 多劑量容器 → 必須添加防腐劑並通過 ⟨51⟩ 測試
blocks.en: Multiple-dose container → a preservative must be added and the product must pass the ⟨51⟩ test

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品 → 需要測 Water Content ⟨921⟩
blocks.en: Lyophilized product → Water Content ⟨921⟩ must be tested

blocks.zh: 非水性溶媒 → 固定油必須通過 7 項品質指標
blocks.en: Nonaqueous vehicle → fixed oils must meet 7 quality criteria

blocks.zh: 復溶產品 → 必須測 Completeness and Clarity
blocks.en: Constituted product → Completeness and Clarity must be tested

blocks.zh: 添加物的「5 mL 分水嶺」：
blocks.en: The "5 mL watershed" for added substances:

blocks.zh: 原文對超過 5 mL 的注射劑設定了更嚴格的添加物限量。為什麼是 5 mL？因為注射量越大，患者接觸到添加物的總量就越多。一個 0.5% 防腐劑在 1 mL 注射劑中只有 5 mg，但在 100 mL 大容量注射液中就是 500 mg — 毒性風險完全不同。
blocks.en: The original text sets stricter limits on added substances for injections larger than 5 mL. Why 5 mL? Because the larger the injected volume, the greater the total amount of the added substance the patient is exposed to. A 0.5% preservative is only 5 mg in a 1 mL injection, but in a 100 mL large-volume infusion it is 500 mg, a completely different toxicity risk.

blocks.zh: 這就像藥物的劑量概念：少量的酒精是調味，大量就是毒。
blocks.en: It is like the concept of drug dose: a little alcohol is a flavoring, a lot is a poison.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 多劑量容器的防腐劑要求
blocks.en: Key Point: Preservative Requirements for Multiple-Dose Containers

blocks.zh: 「必須加」而非「可以加」：原文用的是 “must be added” — 多劑量注射劑必須含有抗微生物防腐劑。這是因為每次抽取都會引入潛在的微生物污染，防腐劑是防止使用中污染（In-Use Contamination）的最後一道防線。
blocks.en: "Must be added", not "may be added": The original text uses "must be added": multiple-dose injections must contain an antimicrobial preservative. Each withdrawal introduces a potential for microbial contamination, and the preservative is the last line of defense against in-use contamination.

blocks.zh: 三個例外：專論另有規定、放射性藥物（半衰期 <24h）、活性成分本身具有抗菌性。
blocks.en: Three exceptions: where the monograph provides otherwise, radiopharmaceuticals (half-life <24 h), and active ingredients that are themselves antimicrobial.

blocks.zh: CDMO 影響：如果客戶要求生產多劑量注射劑，你的配方開發團隊必須進行 ⟨51⟩ 抗微生物效力試驗來確認防腐劑的有效性。
blocks.en: CDMO impact: If a client asks you to manufacture a multiple-dose injection, your formulation development team must perform the ⟨51⟩ Antimicrobial Effectiveness Test to confirm that the preservative is effective.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 「不得加色素」規則
blocks.en: Key Point: The "No Added Colorants" Rule

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1⟩ 明確禁止「僅為了著色目的」在注射劑中添加色素。這個規則在 CDMO 場景中偶爾會引起爭議 — 某些客戶可能希望透過顏色來區分不同濃度的產品。但 USP 的立場很清楚：注射劑不需要也不應該靠顏色來辨識。
blocks.en: USP ⟨1⟩ explicitly prohibits adding colorants to injections "solely for the purpose of coloring". This rule occasionally causes disputes in a CDMO setting, as some clients may want to distinguish products of different strengths by color. But USP's position is clear: injections neither need nor should rely on color for identification.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 是否生產多劑量注射劑？如果是，防腐劑效力測試（⟨51⟩）是在什麼階段進行的？開發階段還是每批放行？
blocks.en: Does your CDMO manufacture multiple-dose injections? If so, at what stage is the preservative effectiveness test (⟨51⟩) performed: during development, or for every batch release?

blocks.zh: 非水性注射劑（如使用固定油的肌肉注射劑）在 CDMO 場景中越來越常見嗎？這些產品的特殊品質要求對 QC 實驗室提出了哪些額外挑戰？
blocks.en: Are nonaqueous injections (such as intramuscular injections using fixed oils) becoming more common in CDMO settings? What additional challenges do the special quality requirements of these products pose for the QC laboratory?

blocks.zh: Container & Labeling Specifications — 容器與標籤規格
blocks.en: Container & Labeling Specifications

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 包裝相容性的 USP 章節地圖
blocks.en: Core Concept: A USP Chapter Map for Packaging Compatibility

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1⟩ 觸發了一整套包裝測試的章節連鎖。這是 CDMO 經常遇到的複雜領域：
blocks.en: USP ⟨1⟩ triggers a whole chain of packaging test chapters. This is a complex area that CDMOs often face:

blocks.zh: ⟨381⟩ — 橡膠部件（瓶塞、注射器活塞）
blocks.en: ⟨381⟩: elastomeric components (stoppers, syringe plungers)

blocks.zh: ⟨660⟩ — 玻璃容器（Type I borosilicate 等）
blocks.en: ⟨660⟩: glass containers (Type I borosilicate, etc.)

blocks.zh: ⟨661⟩/⟨661.1⟩/⟨661.2⟩ — 塑膠包裝系統與材料
blocks.en: ⟨661⟩/⟨661.1⟩/⟨661.2⟩: plastic packaging systems and materials

blocks.zh: ⟨1663⟩/⟨1664⟩ — 可溶出物（Extractables）和浸出物（Leachables）評估
blocks.en: ⟨1663⟩/⟨1664⟩: assessment of extractables and leachables

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：包裝不能改變藥品的 strength、quality 或 purity。這意味著你的容器密封系統需要經過完整的 E&L（Extractables & Leachables）研究。
blocks.en: Key principle: Packaging must not alter the strength, quality or purity of the drug product. This means your container-closure system needs a complete E&L (Extractables & Leachables) study.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CCI 是近年稽查焦點
blocks.en: Key Point: CCI Is an Inspection Focus in Recent Years

blocks.zh: FDA 與 EU Annex 1 的新要求：容器密封完整性（CCI）檢測技術在過去 10 年發生了重大變革。傳統的藍色染料浸入測試（Blue Dye Ingress Test）正被確定性方法取代：
blocks.en: New expectations from the FDA and EU Annex 1: CCI testing technology has changed significantly over the past 10 years. The traditional blue dye ingress test is being replaced by deterministic methods:

blocks.zh: 真空衰減（Vacuum Decay）
blocks.en: Vacuum decay

blocks.zh: 高壓放電（High Voltage Leak Detection, HVLD）
blocks.en: High voltage leak detection (HVLD)

blocks.zh: 氦氣洩漏（Helium Leak Detection）
blocks.en: Helium leak detection

blocks.zh: 雷射頭空間分析（Laser-based Headspace Analysis）
blocks.en: Laser-based headspace analysis

blocks.zh: ⟨1207⟩ 系列提供了選擇和驗證這些方法的框架。CDMO 在選擇 CCI 技術時，需要考慮產品形態（液體/凍乾）和容器類型（玻璃瓶/預填充注射器/安瓶）。
blocks.en: The ⟨1207⟩ series provides a framework for selecting and validating these methods. When choosing a CCI technology, a CDMO needs to consider the product form (liquid/lyophilized) and the container type (vial/prefilled syringe/ampoule).

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 使用哪種 CCI 測試方法？是否已從概率性方法（Probabilistic，如染料浸入）轉換到確定性方法（Deterministic，如真空衰減）？
blocks.en: Which CCI test method does your CDMO use? Have you moved from probabilistic methods (such as dye ingress) to deterministic methods (such as vacuum decay)?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶帶來一個預填充注射器產品，⟨1⟩ 要求你對哪些包裝組件進行相容性評估？
blocks.en: If a client brings a prefilled syringe product, which packaging components does ⟨1⟩ require you to assess for compatibility?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1⟩ 是「觸發器」：當藥品專論引用 ⟨1⟩，就啟動了一整串的品質測試要求 — 這是每個 CDMO QC 實驗室的必做清單
blocks.en: USP ⟨1⟩ is a "trigger": When a drug monograph references ⟨1⟩, it activates a whole series of quality testing requirements. This is the must-do list for every CDMO QC laboratory.

blocks.zh: 章節編號決定法律效力：<1000 = 強制（Mandatory），≥1000 = 資訊（Informational，除非專論明確引用）
blocks.en: The chapter number determines legal force: <1000 = Mandatory; ≥1000 = Informational (unless explicitly cited by a monograph)

blocks.zh: 三層測試架構：Universal Tests（9 大類，全品項適用）→ Specific Tests（按劑型/包裝觸發）→ Dosage Form-Specific Tests（詳見 Section 1）
blocks.en: Three-tier test structure: Universal Tests (9 categories, applicable to all products) → Specific Tests (triggered by dosage form/packaging) → Dosage Form-Specific Tests (see Section 1)

blocks.zh: 微粒控制四層防線：⟨787⟩（蛋白質）+ ⟨788⟩（一般注射劑）+ ⟨789⟩（眼科）+ ⟨790⟩（可見微粒）
blocks.en: Four lines of defense for particulate control: ⟨787⟩ (proteins) + ⟨788⟩ (injections in general) + ⟨789⟩ (ophthalmic) + ⟨790⟩ (visible particulates)
Packaging system chapter chain: ⟨381⟩ → ⟨659⟩–⟨661.2⟩ → ⟨1663⟩/⟨1664⟩ → ⟨1207⟩ series

blocks.zh: 多劑量容器：必須（must）添加防腐劑並通過 ⟨51⟩ 測試，僅三個例外
blocks.en: Multiple-dose containers: a preservative must be added and the product must pass the ⟨51⟩ test, with only three exceptions

blocks.zh: 2024 年 12 月重大修訂生效：確認你的品質系統已更新至最新版本要求
blocks.en: Major revision effective December 2024: confirm that your quality system has been updated to the latest requirements
